title: agentic-stack: a portable .agent folder that gives all your AI coding tools Cursor, Claude, Windsurf
description:
Using Cursor in your IDE, Claude Code in your terminal, Windsurf for second opinions? Each one has isolated memory. Teach one a rule, the others forget it. agentic-stack fixes that. One brain, many harnesses. A portable .agent folder that standardizes your AI's memory, custom skills, and protocols. Drop it into your project and it plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenClaw, or even a custom Python loop.

https://github.com/codejunkie99/agentic-stack
